weight_rule: Training only: multiply base source/curve weights for author terminal retention <=80% by 2; renormalize to training row count. Same sample_weight for non-GP, inverse alpha for GPR. Keep fold-local feature encoding and original base-weight target center/scale.
target_rule: Use the archived terminal minus last early retention target, either in pp or divided by log1p((N-N_observed)/1000). Apply the exact inverse in pp; no clipping.
comparison: Exact archival controls on identical whole-paper splits, full prediction coverage, all 8 configs per cohort. Report <=80%, >80%, and named difficult source separately. An exploratory joint gain requires smaller MAE in both <=80% and >80% subsets.
scope: Exposed development sources. Keep A and early10 research separately. One factor; no outer-result selection.
